properties.description: CI gate over the real binary's tools/list (stdio, through smoke_mcp's Server): every served tool carries a non-empty title distinct from its name, and every tool with readOnlyHint=false states destructiveHint. Refuses to pass on an empty list. Observed failing on main's binary (309 problems: 197 missing titles, 112 missing hints) before the annotations were added. Runs in ci.yml after toolsnap.
properties.name: every_tool_carries_a_title.py
